# r169 certificate data — regDet3 > 0 for 5077a1 (verified 2026-07-31)

Curve `y^2 + y = x^3 - 7x + 6` (5077a1), duplication constant `kappa = 105754`.
Generators used: `P = (-3,0)`, `Q = (-2,3)`, `R = (0,2)`.

These three span an index-2 sublattice: the certified determinant is
`4 x 0.41714 = 1.66856`, four times the classical regulator of 5077a1, which
**quadruples the margin** available to interval arithmetic compared with a
true basis. That is why this triple was chosen.

## The constant Lean must prove

`Real.log 105754 < 11.7836`, by the r153 dyadic route: `2^16 = 65536 <= 105754
< 131072 = 2^17`, so `log 105754 <= 17 * log 2 <= 17 * 0.6931471808 =
11.7835020736`. (The true value is 11.5688709..., but 11.7836 is what the
log-2 bracket gives cheaply, and the certification below uses only 11.7836.)

Window at level 3: `W = 11.7836 / (3 * 4^3) = 11.7836 / 192`.

Each is `x(8.X)`, the third iterate of `x -> f x / g x`, with

## The certified height intervals

`hhat(X) in [ j*0.6931471803/64 - W , (j+1)*0.6931471808/64 + W ]`, `W = 11.7836/192`:

| point | j | lower | upper |
|---|---|---|---|
| `P` | 138 | 1.433226 | 1.566802 |
| `Q` | 126 | 1.303261 | 1.436837 |
| `R` | 91 | 0.924196 | 1.057772 |
| `PpQ` | 246 | 2.602912 | 2.736488 |
| `PpR` | 324 | 3.447685 | 3.581261 |
| `QpR` | 210 | 2.213016 | 2.346593 |

## The determinant

With `a=hhat P, b=hhat Q, c=hhat R` and
`p=(hhat(P+Q)-a-b)/2`, `q=(hhat(P+R)-a-c)/2`, `r=(hhat(Q+R)-b-c)/2`,
`regDet3 = abc + 2pqr - a r^2 - b q^2 - c p^2`.

pairings: p in [-0.200364,+0.000001]  q in [+0.411555,+0.611920]  r in [-0.140796,+0.059568]

**`regDet3 in [1.10013, 2.19508]`, so `regDet3 > 0`.**
(True value 1.66856; the interval is conservative -- plain interval arithmetic,
no correlation tracking between the six heights.)

Level 4 also certifies, at `[1.53011, 1.79659]`, if a tighter margin is ever
wanted; level 3 was chosen because the chain values are already 28-98 digits.

## Remaining Lean work for r169

1. `X_eight_smul` for 5077a1 (third iterate; r153 has the 389a1 analogue).
2. The six `x(8.X)` values and their brackets by `norm_num`.
3. `canheight_window_shift` for 5077a1 (r153 analogue) and
   `log_105754_lt : Real.log 105754 < 11.7836`. `log_bracket_rat` in r153 is
   curve-independent and reusable as-is.
4. Assemble the six intervals, then the determinant, then apply r168's
   `rank_ge_three_of_regDet3_ne_zero`.
